question: How do I maintain consistent speech flow when making multiple text-to-speech API requests?
ground_truth: To maintain consistent speech flow across multiple requests, use the context stitching parameters in your text-to-speech requests. You can provide previous_text and next_text strings to give context about surrounding content, or use previous_request_ids and next_request_ids arrays to reference other generation requests. This helps the model maintain natural prosody and intonation across chunks. For example, when generating a long document in parts, include the previous paragraph as previous_text to ensure smooth transitions between audio segments.

correctness: Must mention previous_text and/or next_text parameters
Should explain the purpose is to maintain consistent prosody/flow
